interface.name: kddw_test_v1

description.summary: drive input from KDDockWidgets' Wayland tests

interface.description:
Private protocol implemented by kddw_test_compositor, so tests can inject pointer and keyboard input that the compositor then delivers through the regular wl_pointer, wl_keyboard and wl_data_device paths.
All requests except commit and destroy are queued. commit plays the queued actions back in order, without blocking the client, which may be inside a nested event loop such as QDrag::exec() while they run. The done event is sent once the whole batch has run, or as soon as one action fails.

request.name: pointer_move

description.summary: move the pointer to a surface-local position

request.description: The position is relative to the surface's top-left corner, so tests don't need to know where the compositor placed their windows.

request.name: pointer_move_absolute

description.summary: move the pointer to a position in output coordinates

request.description: Useful to move outside of any surface, for example to release a drag over empty space.

arg.name: button
arg.summary: Linux evdev button code, such as BTN_LEFT

request.name: key

description.summary: send a key to the surface that has keyboard focus

request.description: Pressing a pointer button over a surface gives it keyboard focus.

arg.name: key
arg.summary: Linux evdev key code, such as KEY_ESC

description.summary: place a toplevel at a position in output coordinates

request.name: wait_for_drag_start

description.summary: wait until a client starts a drag

request.description: Waits for a drag started after the last pointer button press. Fails if none starts within timeout_msecs.

request.name: cancel_drag
request.description: Makes the drag source receive wl_data_source.cancelled without releasing the button, like pressing Escape on a desktop compositor. Releasing the button over no surface cancels the drag too.

description.summary: save what the compositor is showing to an image file

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: echoed back in the done event

arg.name: message
arg.summary: empty on success, the reason on error
